name: frankenstein-factory
description: A software factory: a work item goes in, a reviewed, acceptance-tested change comes out.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && rm -f dist/board.html && mkdir -p dist/board && cp src/board/* dist/board/
scripts.format: eslint src test scripts trackers --fix && prettier --write README.md docs src/board package.json .prettierrc.json eslint.config.mjs
scripts.lint: eslint src test scripts trackers && prettier --check README.md docs src/board package.json .prettierrc.json eslint.config.mjs
scripts.check: pnpm run lint && tsc -p tsconfig.check.json && node --test 'test/*.test.ts' && node --test scripts/*.test.mjs
